headline: Ishraque Hossain to announce resignation as State Minister today at 2 PM
summary: The State Minister for Liberation War Affairs will make the final announcement at the National Press Club, stating he will work as a BNP activist for drug eradication.
details: State Minister for Liberation War Affairs, Ishraque Hossain, is set to make a final announcement regarding his resignation from the post at 2 PM today at the National Press Club. He will also hold a press conference with journalists at the event.
Hossain shared this significant update through a post on his verified Facebook page on Monday morning, October 19, generating widespread discussion.

In his post, he noted the celebratory reactions from some "civilized people" on Facebook. He expressed hope that these individuals would return from abroad to join future nationalist movements if needed.
He further declared his intention to work with "hundred times more enthusiasm" as a BNP activist, rather than an MP or State Minister, focusing primarily on drug eradication efforts.

Hossain also stated that cleanliness programs would be intensified, and he plans to tour various districts to bolster the organizational strength of "Projonmo Dal" nationwide. His reiterated focus is "Not minister, drug eradication! Drug eradication, drug eradication!"
caption:
State Minister Ishraque Hossain will announce his resignation today at 2 PM, declaring a new focus on drug eradication as a BNP activist.

State Minister for Liberation War Affairs, Ishraque Hossain, is set to make a final announcement regarding his resignation from the post at 2 PM today at the National Press Club. He will also hold a press conference with journalists at the event.

Hossain shared this significant update through a post on his verified Facebook page on Monday morning, October 19, generating widespread discussion.

In his post, he noted the celebratory reactions from some "civilized people" on Facebook. He expressed hope that these individuals would return from abroad to join future nationalist movements if needed.

He further declared his intention to work with "hundred times more enthusiasm" as a BNP activist, rather than an MP or State Minister, focusing primarily on drug eradication efforts.

Hossain also stated that cleanliness programs would be intensified, and he plans to tour various districts to bolster the organizational strength of "Projonmo Dal" nationwide. His reiterated focus is "Not minister, drug eradication! Drug eradication, drug eradication!"

headline_marked: Bomb recovered from [[Police recover bomb near Fakir Lalon Shah’s shrine]] in Kushtia
headline: Bomb recovered from Police recover bomb near Fakir Lalon Shah’s shrine in Kushtia
summary: An improvised explosive device (IED) was found and defused by experts early today in the shrine compound during a major spiritual gathering.
details: Police recovered an improvised explosive device (IED) from the premises of the Fakir Lalon Shah shrine in Kushtia’s Kumarkhali upazila early today.
The bomb was discovered near a water tank within the shrine compound around 2:00 am, according to Jamal Uddin, officer-in-charge of the police station.
A team of bomb experts was called in to defuse the device, and authorities stated that the situation has since returned to normal.
The recovery took place during a three-day gathering of spiritual devotees and a rural fair marking the 136th death anniversary of Fakir Lalon Shah.
While the main gathering ended yesterday afternoon with the Purnaseba ritual, the fair and musical performances are scheduled to continue today.
caption:
A bomb was found at the Fakir Lalon Shah shrine in Kushtia early today.

Police recovered an improvised explosive device (IED) from the premises of the Fakir Lalon Shah shrine in Kushtia’s Kumarkhali upazila early today.

The bomb was discovered near a water tank within the shrine compound around 2:00 am, according to Jamal Uddin, officer-in-charge of the police station.

A team of bomb experts was called in to defuse the device, and authorities stated that the situation has since returned to normal.

The recovery took place during a three-day gathering of spiritual devotees and a rural fair marking the 136th death anniversary of Fakir Lalon Shah.

While the main gathering ended yesterday afternoon with the Purnaseba ritual, the fair and musical performances are scheduled to continue today.
